name: std/json
description: Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
readme: Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
Import this module with use json.

files.content:
-- Declares JSON trees and streaming tokens.
public define Value as opaque.
public define Stream as opaque.
public use "json" function parse(source text) giving failable pointer to Value.
public use "json" function write(value pointer to Value) giving failable text.
public use "json" function field(value pointer to Value, name text) giving failable text.
public use "json" function item(value pointer to Value, index unsigned 32) giving failable text.
public use "json" function quote(value text) giving failable text.
public use "json" function kind(value pointer to Value) giving text.
public use "json" function size(value pointer to Value) giving failable unsigned 32.
public use "json" function set(value pointer to Value, name text, source text) giving failable nothing.
public use "json" function append(value pointer to Value, source text) giving failable nothing.
public use "json" function release(value pointer to Value) giving nothing.
public use "json" function stream giving failable pointer to Stream.
public use "json" function feed(value pointer to Stream, chunk text, final boolean) giving failable nothing.
public use "json" function next(value pointer to Stream) giving failable text.
public use "json" function data(value pointer to Stream) giving failable text.
public use "json" function close(value pointer to Stream) giving nothing.
